Settings.LangHint: Language of the map, the Agent phone and generated gigs. “Auto” follows Foundry's language (Russian if Foundry is in Russian, otherwise English).
Settings.ImageHint: The Night City 2045 map file (without legend). Points are tied to this map's proportions.
Settings.WidthHint: Used for distances and travel time.
Settings.ScanHint: A blue scan line that sweeps down the map (each player sets their own).
Settings.ScHint: The map clock follows the “Night City 2045” calendar in Simple Calendar (Foundry world time). The 📅 button on the map clock sets the calendar up.
Settings.AgentHint: The Agent phone opens automatically when you join the game (each player sets their own).
Settings.AgentOnHint: Show the Agent phone: the button on the map, the Shift+A key and the scene control. Off — the Agent is gone for everyone.
Settings.BuyHint: Players buy from shops and Night Markets with the cart button. Eddies are taken from the character and the item goes on the sheet (Cyberpunk RED). Other systems get a chat note.
Settings.CallHint: Sound of an incoming holo-call for players (mp3, ogg, wav). Empty — the module's built-in tone. Volume follows Foundry's interface volume.
Settings.RoadsHint: Grid the routes follow: white streets, gray land, black water, same proportions as the map. Empty — the module's Night City 2045 grid. Small fixes can be painted on the map with the Roads button.
Settings.LightsHint: At night the map lights up: street lamps along the roads, windows and neon by district, fires in the combat zones. Turn off on a slow computer.
Settings.NcartHint: Folder with your own NCART line images (one line per file, same size and framing as the map image; white background is fine). Images are not included in the module.
